metric_unit: percent except counts and average cycles; rounded to two decimals
known_limitations: PostgreSQL not validated; target-engine validation is required before any PostgreSQL pilot, including database-sensitive stories.
Results apply only to the tested Laravel/SQLite scope; other stacks are not validated.
External containment is required for untrusted code; the runner is not a security sandbox.
Shared scaffold and fixed mutation anchors limit generalization beyond tested cases.
Production TLS/transport was not validated by this sandbox campaign.
Distributed rate limiting was not validated.
Human oversight remains mandatory; campaign human code review and Audit were not completed.
Reviewer separation is supported by recorded execution provenance, not cryptographic authentication; boundary hashes cannot exclude transient restored changes.
required_controls: Explicit human authorization before implementation, with approver authority, scope, target, conditions and timestamp.
Complete the Pre-Implementation Gate before bounded Backend Agent work.
Freeze each candidate revision and hashes before independent review; refreeze and repeat affected reviews after remediation.
Independent Security review for every backend story, endpoint or change; independently verify remediation.
Independent Audit review of policy compliance, approvals and traceability according to Foundation policy.
Human final approval after Security and Audit gates; no agent deployment to production.
No production secrets and no autonomous merge; agents may not merge directly to main.
No production database access under RC1. Any separately authorized access requires a separate scope and controls; it does not expand RC1 or permit production writes.
Prefer synthetic/test data; isolate secrets and disposable validation environments with external containment.
Retain authorization, context, candidate hashes, test logs, findings, review identity and human decisions in an access-controlled evidence location with project-defined retention.
Maintain a tested rollback path and stop immediately when required controls or integrity fail.
